aj_support: Escalating GALETECH trial -> embed API returning 500s intermittently since this morning after large test run. Renewal in ~11 days, theyre onboarding heavy. Repro steps + short logs below.
aj_support: logs: `embed-worker: 500 downstream timeout; retry-loop detected; auth-refresh race`
maria_cs: Ack. Marking renewal-watch. @dave_csm please lead customer comms. Need ops/quotas + quick mitigation.
dave_csm: Will take. Draft plan: 1) immediate ack, 2) offer temporary quota bump + client backoff guidance, 3) update timeline and schedule EBR within 48h. Need confirmation from ops/eng on ETA.
zoe_success_ops: I can run quota bump playbook and validate. Please paste incident link and any assignee. Also need a short email template to send.
aj_support: eng-oncall-bot linked INC-2026-238 (eng-runtime). Assignee: eng-runtime-sre. Patch candidate targeted EOD tomorrow; mitigation in review.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-238: priority=P1; status=investigating; mitigation=retry-guard patch in review.
maria_cs: Quick comms template (edit): "Hi <Customer Team>, were aware of intermittent embed errors and actively investigating. We can temporarily raise your request quota and recommend enabling client-side exponential backoff. Eng targets a patch by EOD tomorrow. We'll follow up with an RCA and next steps." :pray:
dave_csm: Good. I'll wait for confirmation that quota bump is applied before sending. Zoe, pls update when done.
zoe_success_ops: Applying quota bump now, running smoke tests. ETA ~20m. Checklist: confirm contact, apply bump, smoke test, note results.
aj_support: Uploaded repro artifacts and minimal curl repro to incident. Happy to join customer call.
zoe_success_ops: Quota bump applied at 1726001380, smoke test passed (sample load). Pushed runbook excerpt to incident.
eng-oncall-bot: ENG update: mitigation reviewed; rolling internal canary now. Patch ETA still EOD tomorrow.
dave_csm: Sending ack to customer now with the template + note about quota bump. Scheduling 30min sync to confirm impact and next steps. Will keep renewal discussions internal until we see impact metrics.
maria_cs: I'll open renewal-watch doc and tag finance for provisional credit approval if incident extends past patch ETA. Keep replies short here so we can compile comms.
aj_support: Standing by for updates; please ping if you want me on customer call. Thanks everyone.
